name: Itsuki Naotaro
source:
A transfer student who appears on TV as an "idol detective." He has stronger spiritual powers than most people and is a narcissist who likes his own face.

[Translated from official profile]

[spoiler]He is called Nao-nii / ナオ兄 by his younger brother, Shinnosuke.[/spoiler]
